qa.overall_assessment: PASS. All three close-gate blockers confirmed fixed in react_template.tpl. FIX A (AC8): saveMutations success handler at lines 2466-2474 calls setEditorTripData to update days[n].stage using stageMut.to_stage ?? stageMut.value — Approve button correctly re-renders as Approved and disabled after save. FIX B (AC20): window.setEditorSelection bridge at lines 2500-2520 inlines cross-meal option copy into editorTripData; editorDay in useEffect deps (line 2538). FIX C (AC22): isGated correctly uses !edSlot at all 5 locations (905, 986, 1068, 1150, 1290) — missing slots get data-droppable=false. Codex gpt-5.5 xhigh adversarial review confirmed all three fixes correct. All 29 ACs pass.

out_of_scope_observations.observation: applyBridge (tap-to-select path, window.applyEditorSelection, lines 2525-2531) does not call the cross-meal copy logic that the drag-drop bridge now uses. If a user taps a cross-meal candidate then taps a different meal slot, the option object is not copied into editorTripData. This could cause the same missing-card symptom on tap flows. Raised by Codex finding 1 as PROPOSED_FIX: factor copy logic into shared helper called from both bridge and applyBridge.

Board-to-board cross-meal drops (direction=board) in onDrop handlers call saveMutations directly and bypass the bridge cross-meal copy. If a breakfast option is dragged to a dinner slot via the board, the option object is not copied into editorTripData. Raised by Codex finding 2.

Bridge sets editorSelections for BOTH target slot and origin slot to optionId when _isCompatible(originSlotId, slotId) is true (lines 2495-2498). For a candidates-to-plan cross-meal drop this can mark the source meal slot as selected with the same option. Raised by Codex finding 3.

All 5 slot-drop overlays set data-droppable=false for missing/gated slots.
